Collections group products; metafields store additional typed information on a resource. Metafield
definitions make custom data consistent and reusable.
Collection එJකන් products category කරගන්නවා. Metafield එJකන් product එකට අමතර

Real-world example
A snack shop groups chocolates and adds a country-of-origin metafield.
